text:
micah: Quick heads-up — RC branch freeze in ~3h (18:00 PT). If you need a late-merge exception, post the PR link + short risk summary + test plan and tag eng-leads. We’ll only approve critical fixes. :rotating_light:
sophia: Requesting exception for PR #7890 — tokenizer bump. Risk: low, affects embed pipeline. Added unit tests and ran staging smoke. PR: https://git.company/PR/7890
jared: Can you add a one-line changelog entry and an example export? Also assign a release owner so we can fast-track review.
micah: Looping in @lisa as release-owner for this window — lisa can you triage and decide whether to escalate?
lisa: Acknowledged. I’ll review in ~30m. If we take it, plan is to cherry-pick to rc/v1.12 and run the canary job. Cherry-pick snippet: ```git checkout rc/v1.12
git pull upstream rc/v1.12
git cherry-pick --no-commit <sha>
# resolve conflicts if any
git commit -m "cherry-pick: PR #7890 tokenizer bump"
git push origin rc/v1.12```
release-bot: build/ci started for rc/v1.12-canary (job 5643) — logs: https://ci.company/job/5643
sophia: Quick smoke: all tests green except one edge-case on long input (token overflow). Investigating now, not seen in unit tests.
micah: If it's only long-input edge-case and we have a clear regression test + mitigation (truncate fallback), we can still consider approving. If the failure indicates core correctness regress, we hold. Please quantify impact and ETA for fix.
jared: I’ll add a regression test and a short rollback plan (revert cherry-pick) — ETA 25m.
lisa: Reminder: if approved, add label `late-merge/approved` and post the rollback command in the PR. We require two eng-leads + release-owner signoff.
micah: Decision deadline 17:45 PT. If no decision by then, the exception is auto-denied to keep the RC stable. Ping me directly for escalations. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
